Harry and Meghan allege reckless paparazzi caused school security scare

Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have accused paparazzi of "extraordinarily reckless" behavior that led to a security scare at their children's school. The couple stated that photographers were spotted outside the school, prompting concerns about their children's safety. Several outlets reported that Harry and Meghan criticized the actions of the paparazzi.
